body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> PowerLab presented ''PXT-40A'' LCD TV with 6ms response time. It is equipped with both analogue and digital tuner and delivers seamless images with the fast response time. ''Twin Pic'' feature allows you to watch two different images at the same time. Panel is covered with fortified black acrylic to protect external shock and it also has touch-sensor type LED blue light.

Gi-soon Park, vice president of PowerLab said that one of the core competences of his company lies in ability to respond specific needs of different markets with its own R&D and manufacturing capability. The company is currently working on the development of IPTV as well as exploration of niche market in Russia.
The company expects to display 17-, 19-inch monitor TV as well as 32-, 40-inch LCD TVs in upcoming CES 2007 Las Vegas, USA.
